description: AgMIP-Wheat and New Zealand collaborators published winter-wheat field experiments at two Canterbury farms over six growing seasons from 2012 to 2018. The trials vary sowing dates and plant densities for the Wakanui cultivar in a high-yielding setting. They include daily weather, soil profiles and starting nitrogen, cultivar information, flowering and maturity dates, biomass, grain yield and yield components. Daily and end-of-season simulations from 29 wheat models are included. The public Harvard Dataverse dataset API confirmed the named version 2.0 release and CC0 1.0. DataCite lists text, JSON and spreadsheet files; no price was shown. A food-supply modeller can check predictions of yield and growth under altered sowing dates and densities. The two farms, one cultivar and non-stressed management limit transfer to other climates or drought conditions. The files were not downloaded, so exact file-to-field mapping and model-output completeness remain unchecked. This is related to other AgMIP wheat benchmarks in this review but is a distinct New Zealand experiment. No catalogue identity match appeared in the full local duplicate scan.
name: Data from the winter wheat potential yield experiment in New Zealand and response to variable sowing dates and densities: field experiments and AgMIP-Wheat multi-model simulations
